title: Chained Tuning Leads to Biased Forgetting
reasoning: The paper evaluates 'biased forgetting' in LLMs using safety and bias benchmarks (ToxiGen, BBQ, and SaFeRDialogues). It explicitly measures and reports performance impacts on religious demographic groups, specifically identifying 'Muslim', 'Jewish', and a general 'Religion' category as groups disproportionately affected by forgetting during sequential fine-tuning.
